common.unknown_command_body:
Command "{command}" is not recognized.
Try /ping, /balance, /record, /income, /chart, or /info.
common.access_denied_body: This command is restricted to administrators.
common.too_short_body:
Sorry, your message is too short or unclear.
Type /info to view available features!
common.general_error: An unexpected error occurred. Please try again later.

language.current_body:
Active language: *English* (en)

To change your language, use:
• `/lang en` - English (Default)
• `/lang id` - Indonesian
language.switched:
> *LANGUAGE UPDATED* ✅

Language has been successfully switched to *English*.
language.invalid:
> *INVALID LANGUAGE* ❌

Supported languages are: `en` (English) and `id` (Indonesian).
Example: `/lang en` or `/lang id`

finance.balance_empty:
No recorded transactions yet.
Start logging with: `/record <amount> <description>`
finance.history_footer:
Page {page}/{totalPages} • Showing {count} of {total} transactions.
Use `/delete <id>` to delete or `/edit <id> <amount> <description>` to modify.
finance.delete_format_error:
Format: /delete <transaction_id>
Example: /delete 123e4567
Use /history to view transaction IDs.
finance.delete_success:
> *TRANSACTION DELETED* 🗑️

Transaction ID `{id}` has been deleted.
finance.delete_not_found: Transaction not found. Check the ID from /history.
finance.edit_format_error:
Format: /edit <id> <new_amount> <new_description>
Example: /edit 123e4567 75000 Dinner
Use /history to find transaction IDs.
finance.edit_success:
> *TRANSACTION UPDATED* ✏️

Transaction `{id}` has been updated successfully.
finance.chart_caption:

reminder.format_error:
Format: /remind add <time> <message>
Example: /remind add 15m Take out the laundry
Units: s (seconds), m (minutes), h (hours), d (days)
reminder.add_success:
> *REMINDER SET* ⏰

I will remind you in {time}: "{message}"
reminder.list_empty:
You have no active reminders.
Set one with: `/remind add <time> <message>`

info.main_intro: I am an intelligent personal productivity bot designed for automated daily briefs, task management, and omni-channel utility.
info.section_finance:
💰 *FINANCE TOOLS*
- `/balance` : Check account balance
- `/record <amount> <desc>` : Record expense
- `/income <amount> <desc>` : Record income
- `/history` : View transaction ledger
- `/chart` : Financial visualization chart
- `/finance_info` : Comprehensive finance guide
info.section_system:
⚙️ *SYSTEM & DEVOPS*
- `/ping` / `/system` : Bot health & resource stats
- `/info` / `/start` : Show this guide
- `/lang [en|id]` : Toggle bot language (English / Indonesian)
info.section_ai:
🧠 *AI AGENT HARNESS*
Send any normal message without '/' to chat or trigger tasks naturally!
- `/model_info` : Available AI models
- `/switch` : Switch active AI brain model
info.section_utilities:
🛠️ *UTILITIES*
- `/weather <city>` : Weather forecast
- `/prayer <city>` : Islamic prayer schedule
- `/remind add <time> <msg>` : Schedule reminders
- `/short <url>` : URL shortener
- `/research_info` : Reference finder (books/journals)
- `/downloader` : Social media media/audio download
- `/me` : About bot creator
info.section_converter:
🖼️ *CONVERTER & MEDIA* 📄
- `/img_info` : Image conversion & removal guide
- `/pdf_info` : PDF tools & merge guide
- `/sticker_info` : Sticker generator guide
